fragrant.en: The adjective stinky means foul smelling, while the adjective fragrant means pleasant smelling.
fragrant.zh: 形容词 stinky 意思是气味难闻的，而形容词 fragrant 意思是气味芳香宜人的。

fragrant.en: So, if we think about things like stinky or fragrant, they're definitely telling us that something is good or bad.
fragrant.zh: 如果我们想想 stinky(臭的)或 fragrant(香的)这类词，它们确实是在告诉我们某样东西是好还是坏。

fragrant.en: They would extract the fragrant oils from flowers, resins, and spices, and distil them to leave only the best-smelling scents.
fragrant.zh: 他们从花朵、树脂和香料中提取芳香精油，并将其蒸馏，只留下气味最好的成分。

fragrant.en: The wealthy bathed in perfumed oils, covered their wigs in fragrant wax, and carried scented cones on their heads that would melt throughout the day, slowly releasing pleasant aromas.
fragrant.zh: 富人们用香油沐浴，在假发上涂抹香蜡，头上顶着香锥，这些香锥会在一整天里融化，慢慢散发出宜人的芳香。

fry.en: Which is exactly what happened at successful restaurants like Kentucky Fried Chicken and McDonald’s.
fry.zh: 这正是像 Kentucky Fried Chicken 和 McDonald’s 这样的成功餐馆所发生的事情。

fry.en: British cuisine, though, is associated with pubs and fish and chips and fried breakfasts.
fry.zh: 然而，英国料理却让人联想到酒吧、炸鱼薯条和煎炸早餐。

fry.en: Fried fish has connections to Jewish communities who came to Britain from Spain and Portugal.
fry.zh: 炸鱼与从西班牙和葡萄牙来到英国的犹太人社区有关。

fry.en: And I said fried chicken, was I right? You are absolutely correct.
fry.zh: 我说是炸鸡，我对了吗？你完全正确。

fry.en: a) turkey ramen b) fried chicken c) takeaway pizza I think the answer is fried chicken.
fry.zh: a) 火鸡拉面 b) 炸鸡 c) 外卖披萨。我想答案是炸鸡。

fresh.en: The reality is that the supply of fresh food to the UK is fragile.
fresh.zh: 现实情况是，英国的新鲜食物供应非常脆弱。

fresh.en: So the meeting was taking place above ground, with the windows open for fresh air.
fresh.zh: 所以会议改在地面上举行，窗户大开着呼吸新鲜空气。

fresh.en: A crunch of a fresh apple is nothing better in the world, honestly, to me.
fresh.zh: 老实说，对我和世界上任何人来说，咬一口新鲜苹果的嘎吱声是无可比拟的。

fresh.en: Danielle says there's nothing better in the world than the crunch of a fresh apple.
fresh.zh: 丹妮尔说，世界上没有什么比咬一口新鲜苹果的嘎吱声更好的了。

fresh.en: Trees and food, fresh water, and the survival of people are vital.
fresh.zh: 树木与食物、淡水以及人们的生存都是至关重要的。

fragile.en: The reality is that the supply of fresh food to the UK is fragile.
fragile.zh: 现实情况是，英国的新鲜食物供应非常脆弱。

fragile.en: Life on Easter Island was always fragile.
fragile.zh: 复活节岛上的生活一直都是脆弱的。

fragile.en: He didn’t want to go straight to the authorities; he knew his brother might be in a fragile mental state, and he didn’t want a raid resulting in him getting shot.
fragile.zh: 他不想直接去找当局；他知道他哥哥的精神状态可能很脆弱，他不想因为突袭搜查而导致他被枪击。

frog.en: The animal world is full of colour – shiny blue peacocks and bright green frogs.
frog.zh: 动物世界充满了色彩——闪闪发光的蓝色孔雀和鲜绿色的青蛙。

frog.en: Just 15 more volts, like a frog in boiling water.
frog.zh: 不过是再多加15伏特而已，就像“温水煮青蛙”一样。

frog.en: Food can have strange-sounding names. If you know what a toad is, it's an animal, very similar to a frog, you might be surprised to hear that a famous English meal is 'toad-in-the-hole'.
frog.zh: 食物可能会有听起来很奇怪的名字。如果你知道什么是toad（蟾蜍），它是一种动物，跟青蛙非常相似，你听到一道著名的英国菜叫“toad-in-the-hole（穴中蟾蜍）”时可能会感到惊讶。

frame.en: The booth can be a single striped canvas sheet thrown over a frame.
frame.zh: 这个布罩可以只是一张套在框架上的红白条纹帆布。

frame.en: In fact, Catherine says that how we frame a memory doesn’t matter.
frame.zh: 事实上，Catherine 说我们如何构建（frame）一段记忆并不重要。

frame.en: And frame can be used as a verb to mean how we think of or describe something.
frame.zh: Frame 可以用作动词，意思是我们要如何思考或描述某事。

frame.en: And political language often frames poverty as a cost to society rather than a sign of deeper problems.
frame.zh: 政治语言往往将贫困构筑为对社会的成本，而不是更深层次问题的信号。

frame.en: Mubarak had always framed it as a simple choice: me, the tough military man you know, or the Islamists.
frame.zh: Mubarak 总是把它塑造成一个简单的选择：我，你认识的强硬军人，或者是伊斯兰主义者。

freedom.en: Today, people care more about freedom and flexibility and the quality of your life.
freedom.zh: 如今，人们更在乎自由、灵活性以及生活质量。

freedom.en: Which means that states have more freedom to draw maps in favor of one party.
freedom.zh: 这意味着各州有更大的自由度来画出有利于某一政党的地图。

freedom.en: One major factor behind the UAE leaving is freedom, freedom to produce oil.
freedom.zh: 阿联酋退出的一个主要因素是自由，即生产石油的自由。

freedom.en: One major factor behind the UAE leaving is freedom, freedom to produce oil.
freedom.zh: 阿联酋退出的一个主要因素是自由，即生产石油的自由。

freedom.en: It had greater freedom of movement and freedom of speech and more culture.
freedom.zh: 它拥有更大的迁徙自由、言论自由以及更多的文化。

frank.en: Frank says that at one point or another, chefs started to make noodle dishes more Japanese.
frank.zh: 弗兰克说，在过去的某个时间点，厨师们开始让面条料理变得更具日本特色。

frank.en: Here's Frank Striegl again, talking with BBC World Service's The Food Chain.
frank.zh: 再次听听弗兰克·斯特里格尔与BBC世界服务部《The Food Chain》的对话。

frank.en: In the hit political drama, House of Cards, the Machiavellian protagonist, Frank Underwood, hatches a plot to become President.
frank.zh: 在热门政治剧《纸牌屋》中，善于权谋的主角弗兰克·安德伍德密谋成为总统。

frank.en: But according to Adam Frank, fossils won't help prove the Silurian hypothesis, as he explains here to BBC World Service programme, CrowdScience: Most things are not fossilised.
frank.zh: 但根据亚当·弗兰克的说法，化石无助于证明志留纪假说，正如他在这里向BBC世界服务节目《CrowdScience》所解释的那样：大多数东西都不会变成化石。

frank.en: Yeah, I agree. Well, it's a question that interests American astrophysicist Adam Frank, who discussed it with his colleague Gavin Schmidt, director of Nasa's Institute for Space Studies.
frank.zh: 是的，我也这么觉得。嗯，这个问题引起了美国天体物理学家亚当·弗兰克的兴趣，他与美国宇航局空间研究所所长、同事加文·施密特讨论了这个问题。

fraction.en: It's only a tiny fraction of Earth's life that has ever become fossilised.
fraction.zh: 地球历史上只有极小一部分生命变成了化石。

fraction.en: A tiny fraction of something is a very small amount of it.
fraction.zh: 某物的“极小一部分”是指非常少的一点。

fraction.en: Sure, that is very impressive, but it really is only a tiny fraction of the depth of the ocean.
fraction.zh: 当然，这非常令人印象深刻，但它真的只是海洋深度的一小部分。

fraction.en: But, even when all global AI use is added together, it still doesn’t even add up to a fraction of a per cent.
fraction.zh: 但是，即便把全球所有 AI 的使用量加在一起，它甚至连百分之一都不到。

fraction.en: The student body had also expanded, but there were still only around 500,000 university students worldwide, a tiny fraction of the estimated 250 million students today.
fraction.zh: 学生群体也扩大了，但全球依然只有大约 50 万名大学生，这只是今天估计的 2.5 亿学生的一小部分。

frighten.en: And his early life was unstable, often unhappy, and at times, frightening.
frighten.zh: 他的早期生活动荡不安，常常不快乐，有时甚至令人恐惧。

frighten.en: Anand used the adjective eerie, meaning strange in a frightening, mysterious way.
frighten.zh: Anand使用了形容词eerie，意思是令人感到害怕、神秘般的奇怪。

frighten.en: To be intimidated means to feel frightened or nervous because you lack confidence in a situation.
frighten.zh: “感到害怕”（Intimidated）意味着在某种情况下因为缺乏自信而感到害怕或紧张。

frighten.en: And the adjective eerie means strange in a frightening and mysterious way.
frighten.zh: 而形容词eerie的意思是带着可怕而神秘色彩的奇怪。

frighten.en: I was surprised and frightened. Now the rat was chasing me.
frighten.zh: 我又惊又怕。这下变成老鼠在追我了。

freeze.en: A less confident speaker might freeze or stop speaking when in the same situation.
freeze.zh: 而不太自信的说话者在遇到同样情况时，可能会僵住或停止说话。

freeze.en: To the Puritans, the invisible world was just as real as the frozen ponds outside.
freeze.zh: 在清教徒看来，无形的世界和外面结冰的池塘一样真实。

freeze.en: Every creak of the floorboards, every howl of the wind through the frozen trees, felt like a sign.
freeze.zh: 地板的每一次吱呀作响，风吹过冰冻树林时的每一次呼啸，都感觉像是一种征兆。

freeze.en: They hunted. They guarded. They herded. They pulled sleds across frozen landscapes where no other animals could.
freeze.zh: 它们狩猎。它们看家。它们放牧。它们在没有任何其他动物能够涉足的冰冻大地上拉雪橇。

freeze.en: Freeze immigration and stop the boats. Restore law and order.
freeze.zh: 冻结移民并制止偷渡船。恢复法律与秩序。

freely.en: This means you can travel freely across Schengen countries without going through immigration checks.
freely.zh: 这意味着你可以在申根国家之间自由旅行，而无需经过出入境检查。

freely.en: My less confident, technically better at Japanese friends sometimes speak a bit less freely.
freely.zh: 我那些日语技术更好、但没那么自信的朋友，有时说话就没那么自由。

freely.en: When I speak, I try to speak freely. I like to get involved in conversations.
freely.zh: 当我说话时，我尽量畅所欲言。我喜欢参与对话。

freely.en: This means that EU citizens can live, work, study, and travel freely across member countries.
freely.zh: 这意味着欧盟公民可以在成员国之间自由地生活、工作、学习和旅行。

freely.en: What's more, by wandering freely around the forest they trample down dead trees, reducing the amount of flammable, meaning easily burned, vegetation.
freely.zh: 此外，它们在森林里自由漫步的同时，还会踩倒枯树，从而减少易燃(flammable，即容易着火)的植被数量。

fridge.en: Now, to put that in perspective, the energy use is like one second of using a microwave, or 6 seconds of having your fridge on.
fridge.zh: 为了让你有个直观的概念，这耗能就像使用微波炉一秒钟，或者让冰箱运行 6 秒钟。

fridge.en: To give you an idea of how this works, the team at People Fixing the World read out some of the messages on one of the ' Bags of Taste' WhatsApp chats Amy, mentor Remember to put the fridge bag in the fridge.
fridge.zh: 为了让你了解这是如何运作的，《People Fixing the World》团队宣读了其中一个“Bags of Taste”WhatsApp聊天群里的一些消息。导师Amy：记得把冰箱里的袋子放进冰箱。

fridge.en: To give you an idea of how this works, the team at People Fixing the World read out some of the messages on one of the ' Bags of Taste' WhatsApp chats Amy, mentor Remember to put the fridge bag in the fridge.
fridge.zh: 为了让你了解这是如何运作的，《People Fixing the World》团队宣读了其中一个“Bags of Taste”WhatsApp聊天群里的一些消息。导师Amy：记得把冰箱里的袋子放进冰箱。

frustrate.en: Yes, it can be slow and frustrating, but for the most part, it works.
frustrate.zh: 没错，这个过程可能又慢又让人沮丧，但在大多数情况下，它是行之有效的。

frustrate.en: They were frustrated that large Western oil companies controlled oil prices and production.
frustrate.zh: 他们感到沮丧的是，西方的大型石油公司控制了油价和产量。

frustrate.en: But if you are listening to this show, AI-generated English might be a little frustrating.
frustrate.zh: 但如果你在听这个节目，人工智能生成的英语可能会有点令人沮丧。

frustrate.en: One of the great, but also frustrating things, about language is that it is constantly evolving.
frustrate.zh: 语言有一点既美妙又让人头疼，那就是它一直在不断演变。

frustrate.en: What makes slang interesting and frustrating is how fast it changes.
frustrate.zh: 让俚语既有趣又令人沮丧的是它变化的速度之快。

frequently.en: Chimpanzees sleep around ten hours a night because their sleep is so frequently disturbed.
frequently.zh: 黑猩猩一晚睡大约十个小时，因为它们的睡眠经常被打断。

frequently.en: He was frequently hassled and shaken down for bribes, forced to pay money to the police.
frequently.zh: 他经常受到骚扰和勒索敲诈，被迫向警察交钱。

frequently.en: These city-states were frequently at war with each other, whether over trade, territory, or sheer political rivalry.
frequently.zh: 这些城邦经常彼此交战，无论是为了贸易、领土，还是纯粹的政治竞争。

frequently.en: You wake up frequently, you sleep lightly and uncomfortably.
frequently.zh: 你频繁醒来，睡眠很浅而且很不舒服。

frequently.en: Many resource-rich nations have struggled with political instability, meaning their governments frequently change or they face lots of conflict.
frequently.zh: 许多资源丰富的国家一直在与政治动荡作斗争，这意味着它们的政府频繁更迭，或者面临大量的冲突。

frequent.en: Are frequent changes in leadership healthy for a democracy?
frequent.zh: 频繁更换领袖对民主制度是健康的吗？

frequent.en: There were frequent accidents and no medical care.
frequent.zh: 事故频发且没有医疗照顾。

frequent.en: Mexico city, however, did face frequent floods.
frequent.zh: 然而，墨西哥城确实面临着频繁的洪水。

frequent.en: And, to complete the picture, he was a frequent gambler, spending much of his time in saloons and playing a card game called faro.
frequent.zh: 而为了让这幅画像更完整：他还是个常年赌博的人，大部分时间都泡在酒馆里，玩一种叫法罗(faro)的纸牌游戏。

frequent.en: The first is that big technology companies are still investing in nuclear energy despite these frequent cost overruns, which gives you some idea of just how desperate they are for power.
frequent.zh: 第一，尽管成本经常超支，大型科技公司依然在投资核能，这让你对他们对电力的渴望程度有所了解。

fracture.en: And then, within fifteen years, this empire had started to fracture.
fracture.zh: 然后，在十五年内，这个帝国开始分裂。

fracture.en: The country effectively fractured. In the mineral-rich south, backed by Belgian mining interests, one province declared independence.
fracture.zh: 国家实际上陷入了分裂。在矿产丰富的南部，在比利时采矿利益集团的支持下，一个省份宣布独立。

framework.en: Let’s start with a simple framework that I always recommend: SMART Goals.
framework.zh: 让我们从我一直推荐的一个简单框架开始：SMART 原则。

framework.en: There is no real vocabulary for it, no framework, and certainly no treatment that could do anything useful.
framework.zh: 没有真正的词汇来形容它，没有框架，更没有什么治疗方法能起到什么真正有用的作用。

framework.en: So he was ahead of his time, but he didn’t really use the tools or framework of modern science.
framework.zh: 所以他超越了时代，但他并没有真正使用现代科学的工具或框架。

framework.en: Darwin changed how we understand life. His theory of evolution by natural selection created a framework that connects every field of biology.
framework.zh: Darwin改变了我们对生命的理解。他的自然选择进化论创造了一个连接生物学各个领域的框架。

framework.en: I think this is a useful framework for thinking about where AI can fit in, especially as almost everyone finds output harder than input; it’s easier to understand English than it is to produce it.
framework.zh: 我认为这是一个有用的框架，可以用来思考人工智能可以切入的位置，尤其是几乎每个人都觉得输出比输入更难；理解英语比产出英语要容易得多。

fragment.en: Housing is unaffordable. Politics in the UK is really fragmented at the moment.
fragment.zh: 住房让人买不起。英国目前的政治局势非常碎片化。

fragment.en: Fragments of the Berlin Wall still stand, and some of the former border zones have been transformed into parks and neighborhoods.
fragment.zh: 柏林墙的残片依然耸立，一些前边境地带已被改造为公园和居民区。

fragment.en: To cut a long story short, over the next three years, Mustafa Kemal turned a fragmented resistance into a disciplined army.
fragment.zh: 长话短说，在接下来的三年里，穆斯塔法·凯末尔将一支支离破碎的抵抗力量变成了一支纪律严明的军队。

fragment.en: While they'd been useful in the fragmented world of Renaissance Italy, they were no match for the organised, professional forces that began to dominate European warfare.
fragment.zh: 虽然他们在四分五裂的文艺复兴时期意大利很有用，但他们根本无法与开始主导欧洲战争的有组织、职业化的军队相抗衡。

fragment.en: About one metre down, in a layer dating to roughly one million years ago, researchers from Boston University found charred plant material and burned bone fragments.
fragment.zh: 在大约一米深、可以追溯到大约一百万年前的地层中，波士顿大学的研究人员发现了烧焦的植物材料和燃烧过的骨头碎片。

friction.en: Remove any obstacles or friction. Make your habits obvious.
friction.zh: 消除任何障碍或阻力。让你的习惯显而易见。

friction.en: Later came the friction method: spinning a dry wooden rod against a flat piece of softer wood until there's enough heat built up to set dry leaves or wood alight.
friction.zh: 后来出现了摩擦法：将一根干燥的木棍对着一块较软的干木头旋转，直到积聚足够的热量来点燃干树叶或木头。

frontier.en: Mapping distant frontiers, after all, was often as politically useful as it was scientifically exciting.
frontier.zh: 毕竟，绘制遥远边疆的地图通常在政治上和在科学上一样有用。

frontier.en: Lake published his book: Wyatt Earp: Frontier Marshal.
frontier.zh: Lake 出版了他的书：《怀特·厄普：边疆治安官》(Wyatt Earp: Frontier Marshal)。

frontier.en: Exploration was the ultimate frontier, and it promised fortune, glory, and the chance to write your name into history.
frontier.zh: 探索是终极的前沿，它承诺带来财富、荣耀，以及将你的名字写入历史的机会。

frontier.en: It was pretty big by frontier standards.
frontier.zh: 以边疆小镇的标准来说，这已经算是相当大的城市了。

frontier.en: He wanted Silicon Valley, Wall Street, and the world to see Saudi Arabia not as an oil state stuck in the past… but as the next great frontier for innovation.
frontier.zh: 他希望硅谷、华尔街和全世界看到的沙特阿拉伯，不再是一个深陷过去的石油国……而是下一个伟大的创新前沿。

fraud.en: A government that reduces jury rights for fraud and robbery has already won the argument in principle.
fraud.zh: 一个已经削减了诈骗和抢劫案陪审团权利的政府，实际上已经在原则层面赢得了这场争论。

fraud.en: Fraud, perhaps, or assault. You maintain that you are innocent.
fraud.zh: 也许是诈骗，或者是人身伤害。你坚称自己是清白的。

fraud.en: Companies or financial institutions might lie and commit crimes, might commit fraud, in order to gain an advantage.
fraud.zh: 公司或金融机构可能会撒谎并实施犯罪，实施欺诈，以此来获得优势。

fraud.en: Corruption can sometimes involve fraud or manipulation as well.
fraud.zh: 腐败有时也可能涉及欺诈或操纵。

fraud.en: Quite often in the news, you will see stories of billions of dollars in oil revenue disappearing through fraud or illegal activities.
fraud.zh: 你经常会在新闻中看到数十亿美元的石油收入通过欺诈或非法活动消失的故事。
